PaymentInstructionPayment.name: PaymentInstructionPayment
PaymentInstructionPayment.description: A junction object that links a Payment to a Payment Instruction, capturing the portion of an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) payment applied to that payment instruction. Supports scenarios where a single payment is split across multiple payment instructions.

Name.description: The name of the payment instruction payment.

PaymentInstructionId.description: The ID of the payment instruction record.

ProcessedAmount.description: Amount paid from the Payment towards this PaymentInstruction.

PaymentInstructionPayment.accessRules: This object is available only if Outbound Payments is enabled in your org, and you have access to Outbound Payments entities.
